title: Delta Lake connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Delta table's settings, read by the native lakehouse family (`loams_connector_lakehouse::delta`, CN2 Task 17) on deltalake 1.1.0 without datafusion (R17.6). `storage.auth.*` hold secret **names** (D189), exactly the manifest's `secrets`; a local `file://` table needs none.

storage.description: Where the table's storage is and how to reach it (S3 and its targets: RustFS, MinIO, R2).

endpoint.description: An S3-compatible endpoint; AWS when absent. It must support conditional writes (`If-None-Match: *`, R17.5).

allow_http.description: Allow plain `http://` endpoints (a local RustFS): development and CI only.

virtual_hosted_style.description: Address the bucket virtual-hosted style rather than by path.

auth.description: S3 credentials, as secret names; the default credential chain when absent.

access_key_id.description: The access key id. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

secret_access_key.description: The secret access key. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

session_token.description: A session token, for temporary credentials. The **name** of a secret in the namespace's store (D189), resolved when the connector connects; never the value.

sink.description: The exactly-once sink: one Delta commit per batch with the `txn` action and the Fabric checkpoint in `commitInfo`.

mode.description: `append`, the only mode built: `merge` needs deltalake's datafusion feature and is refused (R17.6).

partition_by.description: Partition columns of a table the sink creates.

create.description: Create the table from the first batch's schema when it does not exist.

target_file_size.description: Roll data files at this size, in bytes; one file per partition per commit when unset.

source.description: The source: the table's versions or its change data feed, read from the JSON log (R17.6).

mode.description: `versions`: the rows each version adds (`rows`). `cdf`: the change data feed (`change`, with `_change_type`, `_commit_version`, `_commit_timestamp`).

start.description: `snapshot`: the latest snapshot, then every later version. `earliest`: every version from 0 (fails once the log is cleaned up).

poll_interval_ms.description: How often a caught-up source looks for a new version.

max_file_bytes.description: A data file larger than this stops the instance (it is read whole).
